acceptanceCriteria: Owner/spec decision recorded on the problem kind for a destination-less Xcode summary.
If changed: zero-tests yields NO_TESTS and build error yields a BUILD-class problem with live witnesses retained; real destination disagreement still yields INVALID_NATIVE_REPORT.
body: Found by the V1-0594 platform runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1000, head 111cfbebc, 2026-10-17; macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Swift 6.4, Xcode 27.0). For a scheme with zero tests, or a build error, the xcresult summary has no destination, and the xcode-xctest profile refuses with INVALID_NATIVE_REPORT ('Xcode destination reports disagree'). The result is safely incomplete, but the problem code does not distinguish a zero-test selection or a build failure from a corrupt report. Question: should the adapter map a destination-less summary with a build-failure or zero-test signal to the NO_TESTS / BUILD problem kinds, keeping INVALID_NATIVE_REPORT for real disagreement? Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/xcode-xctest/{zero-tests,build-error}/.
title: xcode-xctest zero tests / build error report INVALID_NATIVE_REPORT "Xcode destination reports disagree" instead of a NO_TESTS or BUILD kind
